sentence: This project studies how biomechanical inputs from the cellular microenvironment affect the way adult neural stem cells make neurons.
This project develops a gene therapy that aims to prevent intermediate age-related macular degeneration from progressing to more severe stages.
This project tests whether brain tumor patients can safely avoid a steroid around surgery and whether a different drug can control brain swelling.
This project studies how neurons in the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex are involved in early-life pathological anxiety, using a non-human primate model.
This project builds a machine learning tool that splits a complex bacterial population into its separate cell-states linked to antibiotic treatment failure.
This project develops statistical genetics tools to work out the possible causal effects of circulating proteins and metabolites on complex diseases.
This project studies what young adult women affected by sex trafficking need, to guide an intervention for substance use and HIV risk.
This project builds a tissue engineering platform to study how glioblastoma invades the brain and resists drugs.
This project studies how changes in brain cell function relate to poor decision-making in alcohol use disorder.
This project uses artificial intelligence to improve the detection of carcinoma in situ of the bladder during cystoscopy.
This project tries to find the factors that shape how Kaposi’s sarcoma develops and how patients respond to treatment.
This project studies how high-altitude mammals and zebrafish adapt to hypoxia, focusing on the role of nitric-oxide signaling.
This project measures changes in glutamatergic signaling in the brain, at rest and during tasks, in depressed people at risk for suicidal behavior.
This project tries to find out what the protein zymogen granule 16B does in saliva and in oral inflammatory conditions.
This project provides light microscopy tools and image analysis support for cancer-focused research.
This project combines computational studies, multi-step synthesis and structural biology to design chemical agents that specifically inhibit a family of enzymes.
This project uses single cell epigenomic, transcriptomic and proteomic analyses to map the molecular and genetic basis of lupus in specific immune cell subsets.
This project studies how the human mannose receptor affects infection with Mycobacterium tuberculosis in a transgenic mouse.
This project sets up a research environment that helps network participants communicate and work together on somatic mosaicism across human tissues.
This project uses electronic health record data to find groups of adults with asthma who share risk factors and to build a tool.
